rationale: Record that release pipeline scheduling and compiler-cache wiring cross the design-output-and-packaging selector through release-cli.yml and sign-and-release.yml. The darwin smoke legs move to GitHub-hosted macOS through a separate smoke_map resolver output; sign-and-release skips its macOS job when no signing secret is configured; the release build legs gain the gate's ccache correctness env and a per-job stats step. Configure flags, packaging steps, archive contents and verifiers are unchanged. No importer, DesignIR schema, browser capture path, renderer, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
